# Formula names for The Ivalice Chronicles Mod Studio
# ===================================================
#
# One formula per line:
#
#     <decimal id>|<name>
#
# Ids are DECIMAL, matching what the .nxd files and this tool use.
# FFTPatcher publishes this list in HEX, so 0x6A there is 106 here.
#
# Generated by dev/make_formula_names.py from FFTPatcher's
# PatcherLib.Resources/Resources/AbilityFormulas.xml. That data is
# GPL-3.0-or-later (Joe Davidson and contributors) - see NOTICE.md, which
# explains why this tool is GPL-3.0-or-later too.
#
# Editing this file is entirely your business: the names annotate the
# Formula field and nothing reads them back.
#
